details: Critical (CVSS 9.1) unauthenticated GraphQL on Red Bull's Batalla staging - production-mirrored user data leaked with zero credentials, including a genuine @redbull.com email in the records.
Unauthenticated Coca-Cola API exposing 892 staff records with write access to a production database, plus hardcoded OAuth secrets at Superdrug risking NHS patient data.
NVIDIA subdomain takeover (CVSS 7.5) serving gambling content - recognized on the Intigriti Hall of Fame with 4 severity badges.
Reports to enterprise programs - Goldman Sachs, Adobe, Netflix, Anduril, Flipkart, Cloudflare, OPPO.
Headlined by an authentication bypass (CVSS 8.6) in Netflix's Law Enforcement Portal, plus an Anduril subdomain takeover (CVSS 8.2) via dangling Mailgun CNAME enabling email spoofing/interception.
Infra & supply-chain bugs: build-pipeline RCE, Flipkart/Myntra source maps leaking OAuth secrets, GS Akamai WAF bypass to admin routes.

details: Identified and remediated IDOR, SQL injection, authentication bypass, and RCE vulnerabilities across REST APIs and authentication flows, securing a platform serving 5K+ users.
